title: LOOT IN SIGHT AT EVERY START
why: His g-43 answer: Yes, loot in sight. Baseline missed 53 of 144 starts. The 11-11 amendment permits fallback bands for enclosed starts. Watch: does every start show a box in the first seconds, does the opening become too rich, and do both players converge on the same box.
now: Career and demo reuse a visible ordinary box or add one one-second crate. Prefer 140-320, then 60-140, then 320-480, then the nearest sampled legal point within 600; never closer than 60. After 24 seeded tries a deterministic one-unit, one-degree sweep checks the band before falling back. All placement and loot rolls use side stream 80. Map geometry and the main RNG stay unchanged. Strict checks isolate all 144 starts and require 142 in the preferred band; Cold Mile spawn 3 on seeds 39041 and 61261 must use fallback. No career box-count retarget is known; stop and report any old-check conflict without editing the fixture. No markers or player text. LINKED REVIEW NEEDED: synced (g.containers indices, positions and loot).
